verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes payments, platform, and issuing capabilities in Checkout.com's docs, but no item explicitly documents a public API for driving the product programmatically. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and llms.txt is an LLM-facing site summary rather than an API, so there is no affirmative evidence for this applicable axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
